title: MAC Minute — 2026-10-02
description: MAC Fellas, widebody freighter competition just got loud. Ethiopian Airlines ordered ten Boeing 777Fs. That is a serious fleet expansion for the region. We fly 777Fs too, so more planes in the market could pressure our capacity and rates. Also, Flydubai launched a dedicated cargo network using B737-800 freighters. They are targeting e-commerce and specialized shipments that usually rely on belly capacity. Worth watching, as this may shift regional trade patterns away from traditional carriers. Finally, Xeneta notes shippers are shifting to short-term deals as demand squeezes capacity. Keep your booking flexibility tight; this market is moving fast. Have a good weekend.
